_readme: The adversarial evaluation set for the tag-disagreement refusal gate.
Sixteen concepts the reference library genuinely contains and sixteen it
genuinely does not, each with hand-written visual tags produced by the
same rules the model is given - and deliberately written WITHOUT looking
at what the search returns, so the absent half is not straw-manned.
`present` is drawn from what four independent investigations of this
library established it holds: a decade of festivals, Kashmir and Ladakh,
Puri and Gopalpur, weddings, food, a child growing up, dogs, gardens.
`absent` is things a family library in West Bengal does not hold, taken
mostly from the list an earlier probe used when it failed to find a
Two entries are marked `risky`: they are the ones a reader might argue
with. They are kept and counted, because dropping the hard cases is how a
gate comes to look better than it is.

an astronaut on the moon: a figure in a white spacesuit and gold visor on grey dust
a bootprint in fine grey powder
a lunar module standing on a cratered grey plain
the northern lights: green curtains of light rippling across a night sky
a sky glowing green and violet above a dark horizon
a penguin on ice: a black and white penguin standing upright on ice
a colony of penguins crowded on a snowfield
scuba diving underwater: a diver in a wetsuit and mask with an air tank underwater
a stream of silver bubbles rising through blue water
brightly coloured coral and fish below the surface
a hot air balloon festival: striped hot air balloons inflated in a field
a wicker basket slung beneath a balloon burner
dozens of coloured balloons rising against the sky
skiing on a glacier: a skier in goggles carving a turn in deep powder snow
a chairlift strung above a white piste
ski poles and skis planted upright in snow
a person riding a camel in the desert: a camel with a saddle walking across sand dunes
long shadows over rippled sand under a bare sky
a formula one race car: a low open-wheel race car with wide slick tyres
a pit lane crew changing wheels on a race car
a race car cornering against a painted kerb
a giraffe on safari: a giraffe with a long patterned neck among flat-topped trees
an open-topped vehicle beside grazing wild animals
a lighthouse in a storm: a tall striped lighthouse on rocks with waves breaking over it
a beam of light sweeping from a tower in heavy rain
an ice hockey match: players in helmets and pads skating on white ice
a goal net and blue lines painted under ice
a puck and curved sticks on a rink
a vineyard with grapevines: rows of trained grapevines on wires across a slope
bunches of dark grapes hanging under green leaves
a volcano erupting: orange molten lava running down a black slope
a plume of ash rising from a mountain crater
a medieval castle with a moat: a grey stone keep with crenellated battlements
a drawbridge over water at a fortified gatehouse
arrow slits in a round stone tower
a rodeo with a bucking bronco: a rider in a wide-brimmed hat on a bucking horse
a fenced dirt arena with wooden chutes
a windmill in a tulip field: a wooden windmill with four lattice sails
long straight beds of red and yellow tulips

risky: a medieval castle with a moat
